title: Audit Chain Verification (GET /audit/verify data) — v2
description: Audit hash-chain verification response data. v2 adds `tableRows` beside `checked`: `checked` counts the rows already in the chain, and rows without a `hash` (written before AddAuditHashChain, or inserted directly by tools) are never verified. Publishing both makes the verification rate carry its real denominator. Source: governance-shared/services/audit-evidence.service.ts verifyChain + _chainSlice. / 审计哈希链校验响应 data。v2 在 `checked` 旁边加 `tableRows`：`checked` 数的是已入链的行，而 `hash` 为空的那些行（AddAuditHashChain 之前写下的，或工具直插的）从不参与校验。两者一起出门，验证率才带着它真实的分母。
